summary: Focused iteration_14 retest passed. The reciprocal like at the weekly cap opened the comment flow, POSTed successfully, and displayed the match celebration with animated confetti. A following non-reciprocal like opened the same send flow, received the expected backend 403, and displayed the weekly-limit prompt. Free-user Discovery Filters displayed filter-specific Premium copy. Matching backend regression remained 5/5.
critical_code_review_comments: No regression was found in the requested fixes. matches.tsx remains 1,500+ lines and its focused ESLint run still reports three pre-existing react/no-unescaped-entities errors plus seven warnings; this did not affect the exercised flows.
React Native Web maps testID to data-testid reliably here; the newly added heart, send-like, and upgrade-copy testIDs resolved the prior selector gap and were exercised successfully.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable compatible free students A, B, and C. Only B pre-liked capped user A; C remained non-reciprocal. Cleanup removed all 3 users, 3 sessions, 2 match rows, and 4 notifications.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used the existing verified UI student for Discovery Filters and disposable generated students for capped matching flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_13 matching/UI regressions are resolved. UI network sequence for capped A was POST /matches/swipe 200 for reciprocal B followed by 403 for non-reciprocal C; both prompts and the celebration were asserted. Temporary fixtures were fully cleaned.
rca_of_the_issue: The fixes correctly aligned all layers: backend response-budget arithmetic now excludes reciprocal likes; the frontend no longer pre-gates comment modal opening and instead maps the structured limit error to the likes prompt; filter navigation sets its own prompt context.
